subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a bearer-authenticated HTTP context-engine control API and optional ContextEngine control hooks, and should that surface remain HTTP-only or be mirrored as Gateway RPC methods?
rationale: This PR creates a new operator/admin control surface around context-engine maintenance and a plugin API contract; code review can find defects, but maintainers need to choose the intended product and security boundary.

options.title: Accept after blockers
options.body: Keep the HTTP/plugin control idea, but require the descriptor, initialization, sanitization, docs, and security-boundary fixes before merge.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Restrict this to plugin-owned or internal control until the Gateway API and plugin contract are designed separately.

options.title: Defer core API
options.body: Close or pause the PR until there is a maintainer-sponsored API design for context-engine operations.

recommendation.title: Accept after blockers
recommendation.body: Keep the HTTP/plugin control idea, but require the descriptor, initialization, sanitization, docs, and security-boundary fixes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current routing signal is recent work on Gateway method scopes, descriptors, and HTTP admin surfaces.
